findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.comment: Observed were two dead insects underneath the triple sink and under a rack that stores pizza boxes. The facility has active pest control, however, discussed the need to routinely clean back storage areas to help prevent harboring conditions for insects. There was minimal food residue and other debris on the floors of the back storage area. Ensure that insects are removed and the premise is maintained free of insects.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.111 (A)(B) and (D) Controlling Pests. The PREMISES shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests shall be controlled to eliminate their presence on the PREMISES by: (A) Routinely inspecting incoming shipments of FOOD and supplies; (B) Routinely inspecting the PREMISES for evidence of pests; and (D) Eliminating harborage conditions.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Staff was observed donning new gloves without handwashing. Education was conducted regarding when to wash. Ensure staff are washing hands before donning a new pair of gloves.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.14 When to Wash. FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms as specified under § 2-301.12 immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including working with exposed FOOD, clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, and unwrapped SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and: (A) After touching bare human body parts other than clean hands and clean, exposed portions of arms; (B) After using the toilet room; (C) After caring for or handling SERVICE ANIMALS or aquatic animals as specified in 2-403.11(B); (D) Except as specified in 2-401.11(B), after coughing, sneezing, using a handkerchief or disposable tissue, using TOBACCO PRODUCTS, eating, or drinking; (E) After handling soiled EQUIPMENT or UTENSILS; (F) During FOOD preparation, as often as necessary to remove soil and contamination and to prevent cross contamination when changing tasks; (G) When switching between working with raw FOOD and working with READY-TO-EAT FOOD; (H) Before donning gloves to initiate a task that involves working with FOOD; and (I) After engaging in other activities that contaminate the hands.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Handwashing was unavailable at the time of inspector's arrival. The installed hand sink was not functional. A free-flowing portable hand sink was delivered during the inspection.
findings.citation_text: 5-203.11(A) Handwashing Sinks. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, at least 1 HANDWASHING SINK, a number of HANDWASHING SINKS necessary for their convenient use by EMPLOYEES in areas specified under § 5-204.11, and not fewer than the number of HANDWASHING SINKS required by LAW shall be provided.

findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment: There was a hand brush stored directly above pizzas that were prepped to go into the cooking oven. Discussed and shown to PIC. The brush was moved to a different location. The hand brush is used to brush food residuals from the prep tables. Ensure that hand brushes are stored in a manner that protects against food contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.11(A)(1) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (1) Except as specified in (1)(d) below or when combined as ingredients, separating raw animal FOODS during storage, preparation, holding, and display from: (a) Raw READY-TO-EAT FOOD including other raw animal FOOD such as FISH for sushi or MOLLUSCAN SHELLFISH, or other raw READY-TOEAT FOOD such as fruits and vegetables, (b) Cooked READY-TO-EAT FOOD, and (c) Fruits and vegetables before they are washed; (d) Frozen, commercially processed and packaged raw animal FOOD may be stored or displayed with or above frozen, commercially processed and packaged, ready-to-eat food.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: There is a missing floor tile in front of the triple sink. Repair floor tile. Ensure that physical facilities are maintained in good repair.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
Observed a couple employees turning off faucet handles without a barrier after the handwashing process. Discussed with PIC to educate staff on proper handwashing techniques. Ensure that employees are using barriers to turn off faucet handles after washing hands in order to prevent recontaminating freshly washed hands. 

Also, if tasks change, be sure to wash hands before donning gloves when engaging in food preparation.

2-301.12: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: There is observed a broken floor tile under the pizza oven and a broken floor tile near the triple sink. There is also observed coving in a state of disrepair near the office and near the back entrance door. Ensure repairs are made to these locations to ensure all surfaces are smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: There is observed an accumulation of food debris under the soda storage racks in the corners of the display. Ensure these areas are routinely cleaned to prevent the accumulation of food debris. 
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed mops to not be stored in a position that allows them to air dry. A mop was stored in the mop bucket and in the mop sink. Ensure mops are stored in a position that allows them to air dry. 

6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.comment:
7-102.11: Observed a bottle of sanitizer to not be labeled at the time of inspection. The bottle was labeled during the inspection. Ensure all bottles of chemicals and sanitizers are clearly labeled at all times. 
Working containers used for storing POISONOUS OR TOXIC MATERIALS such as cleaners and SANITIZERS taken from bulk supplies shall be clearly and individually identified with the common name of the material.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.citation_text: 750.540 (C) The food establishment is not under the operational supervision of a Certified Food Service Sanitation Manager that is present at appropriate times. Provide an adequate number of staff with approved training. Reference 750.540.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.citation_text: 7-102.11  (Pf) Observed a spray bottle containing sanitizer to not be properly labeled. Containers of toxic materials must be clearly and individually identified with the common name of the material. The sanitizer was labeled during the inspection.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored
findings.citation_text: 3-304.14  (C) Observed a sani bucket in use that measured 0 ppm of quat. Sani buckets with wiping cloths should maintain a concentration of 200-400 ppm of quat when being used and be changed every 4 hours.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.citation_text: 4-302.14  (Pf) Test strips were not available for use during the inspection. PIC stated that test strips were ordered.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13  (C) Observed dust and soil residue build up on the fan in the walk in cooler. Ensure that the fan in the walk in cooler is cleaned as needed to avoid contamination and to maintain clean.

findings.citation_text: 6-201.11  (C) Observed a broken floor tile near the mop sink. All non-food contact surfaces must be maintained in order to be smooth and easily cleanable.
